description: 9 1/2% 10-year note accruing from 1985-11-15, issued 1985-11-29 due 1995-11-15, priced at 9.54%: settlement inside a regular period, A = (14/181)(C/2).

reference.version: 31 CFR 356 App. B, current eCFR text as of 2026-10-26
reference.convention: Treasury non-indexed note/bond: actual/actual (ICMA-equivalent) semi-annual accrual; price per 100 rounded to six places; fractional first period discounted at simple interest [1 + (r/s)(i/2)]
reference.source: 31 CFR Part 356, Appendix B, Section II (via law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356), Section II.D

tolerance.note: price 1e-6, not 5e-7: the Treasury publishes price and accrued interest each rounded to six places (its own stated convention), and an expected clean price is their difference -- so two independent roundings, up to 5e-7 each, sit between any exact computation and the printed figure. Verified on Sec. II.F, where the library's exact dirty price 102.373540805 rounds to the published 102.373541 and round(dirty,6) - round(accrued,6) reproduces the printed clean price exactly.
